# Q3 Sales Report — James Okafor Highlighted Won Deals

## Overview

This report highlights three key deals closed by **James Okafor** during Q3 2026: **D001**, **D003**, and **D006**.

## Highlighted Deals

| Deal ID | Region | Product | Amount | Close Date | Status |
|---------|--------|------------------------|------------|------------|--------|
| D001 | North | Meridian Insights Pro | $87,500 | 2026-07-05 | Won |
| D003 | East | Meridian DataBridge | $43,000 | 2026-07-12 | Won |
| D006 | South | Meridian Insights Pro | $120,000 | 2026-07-22 | Won |

### Deal Breakdown

- **D001 — Meridian Insights Pro (North):** Closed on July 5 for **$87,500**. This was James's first win of the quarter, landing a flagship product in the North region.

- **D003 — Meridian DataBridge (East):** Closed on July 12 for **$43,000**. A cross-region win in the East, expanding James's footprint with the DataBridge product line.

- **D006 — Meridian Insights Pro (South):** Closed on July 22 for **$120,000**. The largest of the three highlighted deals, this was a significant Insights Pro placement in the South region.

## Summary

| Metric | Value |
|-------------------------------|------------|
| Total deals highlighted | 3 |
| Combined revenue | $250,500 |
| Average deal size | $83,500 |
| Regions covered | North, East, South |
| Products sold | Meridian Insights Pro (×2), Meridian DataBridge (×1) |
| Date range | 2026-07-05 to 2026-07-22 |

All three deals were closed within the first three weeks of July 2026, demonstrating strong early-quarter momentum across multiple regions and product lines.
